title: Generate an ngu-form component from an interface

name.description: Name of the form, such as "signup". The component is SignupForm in signup-form.ts.

model.description: Interface or type alias that describes the value, such as "Signup". It is looked up in the project's source files.

path.description: Folder for the component, relative to the workspace. Defaults to src/app/<name>-form.

project.description: The project to add the component to.

skipTests.description: Do not create a spec file.
